entries.title: Hypertension
entries.summary: Hypertension, also called high blood pressure, is a condition in which blood pressure remains persistently elevated. It can occur without noticeable symptoms, so blood pressure measurement is important for detection.
common_symptoms: Very high blood pressure may be associated with headache
Very high blood pressure may be associated with blurred or changed vision
Very high blood pressure may be associated with chest pain
Very high blood pressure may be associated with difficulty breathing
warning_signs: Very high blood pressure together with severe headache
Very high blood pressure together with chest pain
Very high blood pressure together with difficulty breathing
Very high blood pressure together with vision changes
Very high blood pressure together with confusion
general_lifestyle_information: Regular blood pressure monitoring can help with detection and management.
A healthier diet with less salt can help manage blood pressure.
Regular physical activity can help support healthy blood pressure.
Avoiding tobacco can reduce cardiovascular risk.
Following a healthcare professional's advice is important when hypertension has been diagnosed.
when_medical_evaluation_is_appropriate: Repeatedly elevated blood pressure should be discussed with a healthcare professional.
A healthcare professional should evaluate suspected hypertension rather than the AI system declaring a diagnosis.
Very high blood pressure with concerning symptoms requires urgent medical evaluation.
